mechanism: Amphetamine increases renal tubular reabsorption and reduces amikacin clearance; amikacin ototoxicity and nephrotoxicity risks are elevated with amphetamine-induced sympathomimetic effects and potential dehydration.
action: Monitor renal function (serum creatinine, BUN) and amikacin levels; ensure adequate hydration; consider alternative antibiotic if amphetamine use cannot be discontinued; assess for ototoxicity symptoms.
